notes.title: How to play the high-quality version
notes.notes:
We have released a high-quality version of this title.
The high-quality version has a capacity of 1GB.
As it is against the concept of this title, it will be treated as a beta rather than a final version.

How to play
Right-click the game name in the STEAM app.
Click Properties.
Click Beta.
Select a version from the drop-down list.

notes.title: Pre-release update
notes.notes:
Version 1.20
Added Cut Scenes.
Added Simplified Chinese, Spanish, Portuguese, German and French.
Gaming capacity increased to 339 MB.
Test play completed.

Version 1.10
Add aerial battles. Gaming capacity increased to 264 MB.

Previous versions can be played by right-clicking on the game name from the STEAM app and selecting Beta from the properties.
